title.en: An Act Establishing a Regular District Office of the Land Transportation Office in the Municipality of Malita, Province of Davao Occidental and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a Regular District Office of the Land Transportation Office in the Municipality of Malita, Province of Davao Occidental and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập một Văn phòng Khu vực Chính quy Land Transportation Office tại Đô thị Malita, Tỉnh Davao Occidental, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งสำนักงานเขตปกติ Land Transportation Office ในเทศบาล Malita จังหวัด Davao Occidental และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้

text.en: There shall be established a regular district office of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) in the Municipality of Malita, Province of Davao Occidental to be known as the Malita Land Transportation District Office which shall exercise jurisdiction over all municipalities of the province.

The Secretary of the Department of Transportation and Communications shall immediately include in the Department’s programs the operationalization of the LTO District Office in the Municipality of Malita, Province of Davao Occidental, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days following its publication in two (2) newspapers of general circulation.
